question: Why is the totality not revealed all at once in a single place?
premises: The totality could in principle be revealed.
Fear and fearfulness condition limited perception.
Because of this limitation, simultaneous revelation in one place does not occur.
inference: Fearful limitation prevents the whole from being revealed at once in one locus.
plain_english: Because of fear and fearfulness, the whole is not revealed all at once in one place.
